known_defects: v2: the three member routes enter the Arista box's left edge as short risers that run up beside the box (evidence/v2/v2-text.txt lines 15-31). Each arrowhead is separate and no two routes share a corridor, but a reader has to follow a riser column upward instead of reading one straight line.
v1 is deliberately small (2 edges, 4 nodes). The three-edge host-plus-gateway shape was tried first and rejected: the short gateway-side route had no unambiguous label slot.
The dashed gw->airtel edge (v3) shows the *uncertainty of the path between*, not a polarity or a rate; its label carries `L2?` in text so the meaning does not depend on the dash.
Isolated note nodes (v1 `up 1.5 d ...`, v2 `/29 ...`, v3 both notes) carry facts, not relations; they have no edges and the check places no route for them.
blockers: None on capability: group, style: dashed, dots: 0 and explicit layers covered every shape these views needed.

Measurement caveat, not a blocker: `--check` runs outside a pane and prints `viewport: unknown zoom: 1.00 natural`, so the size proof is the live app's own header token `77x47 @100%` captured in each *-text.txt line 1. viz-evidence.sh recorded pane_rect=null but pane_rows=47.
